en: Alodia as a medieval Nubian kingdom in what is now central Sudan, with its capital at Soba near modern Khartoum
Its foundation after the fall of Kush around 350 CE and its first mention in 569
Its conversion to Christianity in 580, the last of the three Nubian kingdoms to do so
Its peak in the ninth to twelfth centuries and its end around 1500
zh: 阿勒底亚是今苏丹中部的努比亚中世纪王国，首都索巴位于今喀土穆附近
约350年库施衰亡后立国，569年首次见于记载
580年皈依基督教，是三个努比亚王国中最晚的一个

politics.zh: 阿勒底亚是尼罗河交汇地带的中世纪努比亚王国，首都索巴在今喀土穆附近，约在库施衰亡后的350年前后立国，569年首次见于记载。国王之下设省级长官治理，是一个多族群的国家。9至12世纪它与北邻马库里亚保持密切的王室联系，在规模、军力和经济繁荣上超过后者。13世纪起衰落，约1500年索巴落入阿拉伯势力与丰吉苏丹国控制。
politics.en: Alodia was a medieval Nubian kingdom in the Nile confluence region, with its capital Soba near modern Khartoum. It emerged after the fall of Kush around 350 CE and is first mentioned in 569. A king ruled through provincial governors over a multicultural population, and between the ninth and twelfth centuries the kingdom exceeded its northern neighbour Makuria in size, military power and prosperity. Decline set in during the thirteenth century, and Soba passed to Arab and Funj control around 1500.

economy.zh: 王国依托尼罗河两岸的农业，并处在连接埃及与南方内陆的商路上。首都索巴是这一带的城市与贸易中心，9至12世纪的记载称其经济繁荣超过马库里亚。供养王廷与教会的农业剩余和过境贸易构成王国财力的基础。
economy.en: The kingdom rested on agriculture along the Nile and on trade routes linking Egypt with the southern interior. Soba served as the region's urban and commercial centre, and ninth- to twelfth-century records describe an economy more prosperous than that of Makuria. Agricultural surplus and transit trade sustained the royal court and the church.

culture.zh: 阿勒底亚在580年皈依基督教，是努比亚三国中最后接受基督教的一个，此前诺巴提亚与马库里亚已经皈依。王国人口多族并存，古努比亚语中称其为阿鲁阿，阿拉伯语称阿勒瓦。其后阿拉伯语与伊斯兰文化随商路和移民逐渐扩展。
culture.en: Alodia converted to Christianity in 580, the last of the three Nubian kingdoms to do so after Nobadia and Makuria. Its population was multi-ethnic, and the kingdom was known as Aroua in Old Nubian and Alwa in Arabic. Arabic language and Islamic culture later spread with trade and settlement.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约350年立国、569年首次见于记载、580年皈依基督教、9至12世纪的鼎盛，以及13世纪开始的衰落和约1500年索巴易主；丰吉苏丹国于1504年建立后取代了它在尼罗河中游的地位。
events.en: Key moments are the foundation around 350, the first record in 569, the conversion of 580, the peak of the ninth to twelfth centuries, the decline from the thirteenth century and the loss of Soba around 1500, after which the Funj Sultanate of 1504 took its place on the middle Nile.

value.zh: 首都索巴位于今喀土穆附近的尼罗河交汇处。
value.en: Its capital Soba stood near modern Khartoum at the confluence of the Nile.

value.zh: 580年皈依基督教，是努比亚三国中最晚的一个。
value.en: It converted to Christianity in 580, the last of the three Nubian kingdoms.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 本站疆域记录跨越约1150年但只有3条，条目按王国存续期叙述，不据此推断疆域变化。
entries.scopeNoteEn: The atlas holds only three records across some 1,150 years, so the essay follows the kingdom's duration without inferring territorial change from them.

en: The Beylik of Tunis as the political form of present-day Tunisia between 1705 and 1881
Rule by the Husainid dynasty and gradual independence from the Ottoman Empire
The constitution adopted between 1861 and 1864, the first in Africa and the Arab world
Its own currency, army and flag, and the French protectorate from 1881
zh: 突尼斯贝伊国是1705至1881年间今突尼斯的政治形态
由侯赛因王朝统治，并逐步脱离奥斯曼帝国取得自主
1861至1864年间颁布宪法，为非洲与阿拉伯世界首部
拥有自己的货币、军队与国旗，1881年起成为法国保护地

politics.zh: 突尼斯贝伊国是1705至1881年间今突尼斯的政治实体，由侯赛因王朝统治，统治者称贝伊。它名义上仍尊奥斯曼苏丹为宗主，实际逐步取得自主，拥有自己的军队与行政。1861至1864年间它颁布宪法，成为非洲与阿拉伯世界最早的君主立宪政体；1881年法国建立保护地后，贝伊仍名义上保留国家元首地位。
politics.en: The Beylik of Tunis was the political form of present-day Tunisia between 1705 and 1881, ruled by the Husainid dynasty whose head was called the Bey. It remained nominally subject to the Ottoman sultan while gaining practical independence, with its own army and administration. Between 1861 and 1864 it adopted a constitution, the first constitutional monarchy in Africa and the Arab world; after the French protectorate of 1881 the Bey remained nominally head of state.

economy.zh: 贝伊国发行自己的货币，国家财政与地方税收、港口贸易相连。19世纪的改革与借款使其财政日益依赖欧洲资本，最终成为法国以保护地形式介入的背景之一。
economy.en: The beylik issued its own currency, and its finances drew on taxation and port trade. Nineteenth-century reforms and borrowing made the state increasingly dependent on European capital, one of the circumstances behind the French protectorate.

culture.zh: 侯赛因王朝统治下的突尼斯以伊斯兰学术与城市文化著称，首都突尼斯城是行省行政与商业中心。1861年宪法和国旗等国家象征被后世视为突尼斯国家认同的早期要素。
culture.en: Under the Husainids, Tunis was a centre of Islamic scholarship and urban culture, and the capital served as the seat of provincial government and commerce. The 1861 constitution and the flag adopted in 1831 are later treated as early elements of Tunisian national identity.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1705年侯赛因王朝建立、19世纪逐步脱离奥斯曼控制、1831年采用沿用至今的国旗、1861至1864年立宪，以及1881年法国建立保护地；此后贝伊职位保留至1957年共和国成立。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of Husainid rule in 1705, the gradual detachment from Ottoman control, the flag adopted in 1831 and still in use, the constitution of 1861-1864 and the French protectorate of 1881, after which the bey retained a symbolic role until the republic of 1957.

value.zh: 1861至1864年间立宪，为非洲与阿拉伯世界最早的君主立宪实践。
value.en: Its constitution of 1861-1864 was the earliest constitutional monarchy in Africa and the Arab world.
The flag adopted in 1831 is still in use today.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该政体的独立条目，条目叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no separate article on this polity, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: The Emirate of Nekor as an emirate in the Rif area of present-day Morocco
Its foundation in 710 CE by Salih I ibn Mansur through a Caliphate grant
The Banu Salih dynasty ruling until about 1015
Successive polities controlling the Rif between the eighth and fourteenth centuries
zh: 内寇尔王国是今摩洛哥里夫地区的酋长国
710年由萨利赫一世依哈里发授权建立
萨利赫家族统治至约1015年
8至14世纪里夫地区先后由多个政治体控制

politics.zh: 内寇尔王国又称萨利赫家族酋长国，中心在今摩洛哥北部里夫山区，初都特姆萨曼，后迁内寇尔。710年萨利赫一世·本·曼苏尔依哈里发授权立国，其后裔萨利赫家族统治至约1015年。统治家族的血统有也门希木叶尔阿拉伯与纳夫扎柏柏尔两说。8至14世纪间里夫地区先后由多个政治体控制。
politics.en: The Emirate of Nekor, also called the Salihid Emirate, lay in the Rif mountains of northern Morocco, with its capital first at Temsamane and later at Nekor. It was founded in 710 CE by Salih I ibn Mansur under a Caliphate grant, and his Banu Salih dynasty ruled until about 1015. The ruling house is described either as of Himyarite Arab or of Nafza Berber descent, and between the eighth and fourteenth centuries several polities controlled the Rif.

economy.zh: 里夫山区面向地中海，农业与山地牧业是基础，沿海港口参与地中海贸易。内寇尔城的建立使这一带成为区域行政与交换中心，但史料对其财政细节记载有限。
economy.en: Facing the Mediterranean, the Rif rested on agriculture and mountain pastoralism while its coastal ports took part in Mediterranean trade. The town of Nekor became a regional administrative and exchange centre, though the sources say little about its finances.

culture.zh: 立国后当地柏柏尔部族接受伊斯兰教，阿拉伯语与伊斯兰制度随统治者进入里夫地区。家族血统的阿拉伯或柏柏尔两说，本身反映了这一时期族群与政治认同的混合。
culture.en: After the emirate's foundation the local Berber tribes adopted Islam, and Arabic language and Islamic institutions arrived with the rulers. The competing Arab and Berber accounts of the dynasty's descent reflect the mixed ethnic and political identities of the period.

events.zh: 关键节点包括710年立国、萨利赫一世一度被废后又复位、萨利赫家族统治延续至约1015年，以及此后里夫地区在不同政治体之间的反复易手。
events.en: Key moments are the foundation in 710 CE, the deposition and restoration of Salih I, the Banu Salih rule that lasted until about 1015, and the subsequent shifts of control over the Rif between different political entities in the region.

value.zh: 710年由萨利赫一世·本·曼苏尔依哈里发授权建立。
value.en: Founded in 710 CE by Salih I ibn Mansur under a Caliphate grant.

value.zh: 首都初在特姆萨曼，后迁至内寇尔。
value.en: Its capital moved from Temsamane to Nekor.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该政体的条目，条目依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this emirate; the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.
